items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: And he always, when I play with him, comes up while we're playing

ctx.x: Bob Doyle, he had a variety of piano players.

Bob Doyle was a fine piano man. I had a mighty nice thing happen to me, this last jazz thing that they had, right across the street from Sheraton, the Sheraton Canal. And they were calling on different piano players to play, and there was three or four piano players that asked Jimmy LaRocca, and I happened to be one of them, and they said, well, what piano player do you want? He said, I don't want anybody but Jeff. That was mighty sweet. And he always, when I play with him, comes up while we're playing, and while…
